verdict.rationale: MX clearly documents transaction history depth (90 days standard via Account Aggregation, up to 24 months via Extended Transaction History) and provides a sync mechanism via webhooks plus automatic ~24hr re-aggregation of connected accounts, backed by a public OpenAPI spec for the Platform API. However, the evidence never explicitly documents pagination parameters/behavior for the transactions endpoint itself, and the webhook-based sync isn't described as an incremental 'only what changed' diff pattern (e.g., no mention of delta/cursor tokens). Missing for 10: explicit pagination documentation for transaction list endpoints, explicit incremental/delta sync mechanism beyond generic webhooks/24h refresh.
